title: Czech Craft Beer Tasting for Two
description: Czech craft beers with snacks, for two.
redemption_instructions: Show the voucher code to your host.
highlights: Beers brewed on site|A brewer talks you through each glass|Walk in, no booking needed
about_merchant: Pivovar Maniny is a microbrewery in a former tram depot. It brews eight beers a season and pours them ten metres from the tanks.

title: Vltava Dinner Cruise
description: Two-hour dinner cruise on the Vltava.
redemption_instructions: Show the voucher code at the pier 20 minutes before departure.
highlights: Two hours on the Vltava at sunset|Three courses served at your table|Departs from the centre
about_merchant: Vltava Boats runs two glass-roofed boats from Dvorakovo nabrezi. Dinner is cooked on board by a crew of four.

title: Escape Room
description: A 60-minute escape room for your group.
redemption_instructions: Enter the voucher code when you book your slot online.
highlights: Three rooms to choose from on the day|Hints from the game master if you get stuck|Good for first-timers
about_merchant: Escape Holesovice built its rooms by hand in an old print shop. A game master watches every game and steps in only when asked.

title: Trdelnik Baking Class
description: Bake and eat your own trdelnik.
redemption_instructions: Show the voucher code to the instructor.
highlights: You bake it and you eat it|All ingredients and aprons provided|Small groups of eight
about_merchant: Sweet Praha Studio is a teaching kitchen in Holesovice. Classes are run by two pastry cooks who used to sell trdelnik in the Old Town.
